title: Mga Glitch sa Guniguni
summary: This is the portfolio that won me the Ateneo College Awards of the Arts in Poetry and the Mulry Award. I had fun collecting and compiling work I wrote in college, and realizing I had honed a distinct voice as a poet.

title: René
summary: Published in Heights Ateneo. Originally written during my first year and slowly refined as I grew in college. Digitally manipulated self-portraits parodying Magritte, paired with deeply personal poems meditating on the act of editing the artwork.
